Which of the following statements is false about UPGMA?
options: UPGMA is a simple clustering heuristic that proceeds via iterative pairwise grouping in each step.
Given a distance matrix, it starts by grouping two taxa with the largest pairwise distance in the distance matrix.
The distances between this new composite taxon and all remaining taxa are calculated to create a reduced matrix.
The grouping process is repeated and another newly reduced matrix is created.
questions.correct_answer: Given a distance matrix, it starts by grouping two taxa with the largest pairwise distance in the distance matrix.
